tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Concrete grey in Apron, cab-at-night navy in Tower night. Everything else sits on this.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Panels, tables and sidebars on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Raised objects on surface-200: flight strips, inputs, quiet buttons, bubbles with no role.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of controls, strips and chips. At least 3:1 on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300 in both themes. Also the rule joining steps in a trace chain.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300. Fill of the Approve button. Also the 2px selection outline for linked objects and the fill of the note-reader diamond.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300. 4.5:1 or better on all three.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (Approve button).

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Taxiway yellow. Fill for held aircraft, the hold-short line and the SkyQueue result bar. Never text on a surface; pair with on-hold or a 2px ink outline.

tokens.name: on-hold
tokens.usage: Text on a hold fill.

tokens.name: hold-tint
tokens.usage: Background of 'a person needs to look' states: BACKUP plans, ambiguous notes, ambiguous readings, memory-aid banners on strips, reading cells that differ, and soft-rule misses.

tokens.name: hold-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on hold-tint, including banner text and low-confidence values.

tokens.name: tower
tokens.usage: Tower agent identity. Text on surface-100, surface-300 and tower-tint; fill behind the T glyph with on-role text.

tokens.name: tower-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Tower speech bubbles.

tokens.name: pilot
tokens.usage: Pilot agent identity. Text on surface-100, surface-300 and pilot-tint; fill behind the P glyph with on-role text.

tokens.name: pilot-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Pilot speech bubbles.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Ground agent identity (ramp high-vis, darkened to pass 4.5:1). Text on surface-100, surface-300 and ground-tint; fill behind the G glyph with on-role text.

tokens.name: ground-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Ground speech bubbles.

tokens.name: on-role
tokens.usage: Text on a tower, pilot, ground or fail fill.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Rule passed. Text and outline on pass-tint, surface-100 and surface-300. Always with a check mark and the word PASS.

tokens.name: pass-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a passed rule chip and of an accepted note reading.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Rule failed or plan rejected. Fill of a failed rule chip (with on-role text), text on fail-tint and surfaces. Always with a cross mark and the word FAIL.

tokens.name: fail-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a failed rule row, of ignored injection notes and their strip banners, and of a broken trace step.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface and tint.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Slide titles and the cover wordmark. One per slide.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles in the app and slide headings.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: agent names, table headers, provenance tags. Set the text in capitals in markup.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pilot asks to hold DL455 at the gate until 14:20.
styles.usage: Plan summaries and slide body copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Gate B12 has no ground power, so no engines-off hold there.
styles.usage: Default UI text, agent rationales, notes.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footnotes and hints under values. Use ink-muted.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Headline times and counts. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Flight numbers, gates, times, minutes, kilograms, rule IDs, message IDs, line IDs and confidences.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Chips, message IDs, plan line IDs, note IDs and constraint JSON.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips; gap between cover blocks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside bubbles, strips and table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between rounds.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Slide margins; space around the cover wordmark.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Flight strips, tables, hold lines. Signage corners are nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs, agent glyphs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Speech bubbles, plan card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Round-count dots only.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and dense table buttons.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Approve and Reject on the plan card: touch-safe.

tokens.name: size-strip
tokens.usage: Minimum height of one flight strip.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The plan card only. Everything else is flat and separated by line-strong, as on a paper flight strip.
